name: MarkaKalkan Public Lite Risk Scan Gateway - V1

parameters.content:
## HRT-MKT-TR-1D-3D-B4-B5 — INACTIVE GATEWAY V2

This parent workflow returns HTTP 202 only after the provider handoff is durably accepted by Firestore through acceptPublicLiteRiskScanHandoff. It contains no marketplace acquisition and no result callback. Do not activate until credential binding, inactive import, backend deployment, index/TTL operationalization, reconciliation/redrive, and controlled live validation are complete.

## Durable provider handoff

Request: risk-scan-public-lite-provider-handoff-request-v1

Receipt: risk-scan-public-lite-provider-handoff-receipt-v1

Endpoint: https://europe-west3-markakalkan-app.cloudfunctions.net/acceptPublicLiteRiskScanHandoff

Header: X-MarkaKalkan-Public-Lite-Handoff-Token

The dedicated header credential is metadata-only in the workflow JSON; no token value may be embedded.
